notes:
Read-along reads the chapter ahead of itself.

Working out what a tall webtoon page says takes about fifteen seconds on a phone. That wait used to land the moment you pressed play — silence, with nothing to say why. The app now works through the rest of the chapter in the background while the voice reads the pages it has already done, so the wait is paid once, out of sight, and never again for that chapter.

Reader settings has a "Prepare this chapter" button with a progress bar if you would rather do it before pressing play.

This also removes the rule that everything had to run faster than speech — which is what has been keeping better voices out.
